snippet.title: Sub Terra | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The official trailer for my first game, Sub Terra, releasing August 15th.

► Wishlist Sub Terra now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3696090/Sub_Terra/

I've worked solo on this game for about a year now and am so excited to release it. Follow me if you want to stay up to date on Sub Terra and future projects. If you'd like to support me feel free to donate to my Ko-fi.

X - https://x.com/artescaper
Ko-Fi - https://ko-fi.com/artescape
